Roth }} '''Blood Rage''' applies a [[buff]] that deals [[physical]] [[self-damage]] to the player over time, while increasing [[attack speed]] and [[life leech]]. Killing an enemy while this buff is active refreshes the buff duration, and has a chance to grant a [[frenzy charge]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== '''Physical damage reduction''': Damage dealt by Blood Rage is lowered by [[physical damage reduction]]. Note that [[armour]] only reduces physical damage from [[hit]]s, and thus does not affect the damage taken from Blood Rage. Much like [[Righteous Fire]] the damage from this skill does not count as a hit so does not trigger [[Cast when Damage Taken Support|Cast when Damage Taken]]. Only the most recently applied Blood Rage buff remains active, so triggering Level 1 Blood Rage with an effect such as {{ml|JunMasterVeiledLocalAttackSpeedAndLocalDisplayTriggerLevel1BloodRageOnKillChance_}} after casting level 20 Blood Rage will override the higher level buff. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = increased
